title: PG-03.5 Cross-language protocol vectors (crdt-merge-rs)
request: Programme contract for work package WP03 in crdt-merge-rs: Cross-language protocol vectors. Supersedes PG-03.3 (signed; the PG-03.3 file is unchanged and stays on record, and the manifest and RECONCILIATION mark it superseded by this contract). Reason: the signed PG-03.3 cannot be met as scoped because the Rust edition lacks the features its vectors need (an ORSet type key, optional tombstones on read, the canonical sort, LWWMap, AgentState, and node_id on LWWRegister); the signer decided to supersede it with a contract that builds them. Depends on contracts: PG-03.1 (signed). The Python serialisation is that of crdt-merge main 252c93e6. Proposed and unsigned; the signer signs it after the red-team gate. Source: the programme decomposition of 31 Oct 2026 (docs/scope-one/programme/WBS.md, docs/scope-one/programme/DECOMPOSITION.md, docs/scope-one/programme/fragments/WP03.json) and the owner notes behind docs/scope-one/programme/REQUIREMENTS.md. Depends on tasks outside this contract: WP03-01. Covers only what the Scope One contracts (SO-1.01 to SO-1.11) do not already cover; the mapping is in contracts/programme/manifest.json.   Owner decisions of 31 Oct 2026 apply: crdt-merge stays in its own repository and is reached only across the WO-05-A call-out boundary (never vendored, no memev-merge); tiers are free core, Personal at $12/month or $120/year for up to 3 computers, and contact us above that; there is no Federated tier.
